title: Microbial Growth Kinetics: Growth Rate and Generation Time
method: Whitespace-delimited visible theory paragraphs, including worked explanations, excluding headings, tables, figures/captions, questions, references, and UI. Total article includes headings, captions, questions and references but excludes SVG and zoom buttons.
comparator: 2.E.01 checkpoint reports 14477 narrative words; 2.E.04 reports 14080. This chapter uses 17 substantive theory sections with mathematical derivations, interpretation and worked examples. No Monod or reactor-design expansion.
scientific_checks: Official revised CSIR–DBT NET Unit 2.E printed page 3, separate NET Unit 2.E page 2, archived MP SET 2024 page 2 visually inspected. Reviewed binary multiplication, fractional generations, log bases, rate derivations, units, regression, measurement proxy errors, balanced growth, physiological shifts, piecewise rates and lag, net production/loss, population mixture, uncertainty and rate vs yield. Classical 1958 papers verified by journal abstracts; 2024 microbial primer and OpenStax consulted. First review strengthened historical observations and controls, corrected figure description; second review clarified graph interpretation, checked math and references. All practice and illustrative data original. Recalculated examples and practice including 45.096 min, 116.056 min, 60.206 min, 5.756 h, 0.62 h^-1, 46.422 min, 11.023-fold, 30 min, 2.000 h, 7.644 h, 0.57565 h^-1, 52.413–70.155 min, 796828 cells/mL, 2.89435 h.
